sections.heading: How to Play Affliction
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Affliction"][color=c9]Affliction Warlock Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]

Affliction Warlock is a fairly simple generator \u279c spender rotation at its core. With a few short cooldowns, there are just a small handful of rules to follow in general:

[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02 size=medium type=round color=c9 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c9]Don't overcap your Soul Shards[/color] -[/b] Soul Shards are your resource and are limited to a max of 5. Overcapping on them is a DPS loss, and they should not be pooled unless heading into a damage window.
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=spell_shadow_twilight size=medium type=round color=c9 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c9]React to procs[/color]-[/b] Both [spell=1260264] and [spell=108558] will proc often, which players need to be aware of to maximize damage and not overcap on the effects..
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=3255 icon=spell_shadow_deathcoil]Affliction Warlock Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.body:
[h2 toc=false type=bar]Pre-Combat Check[/h2]
	Before any combat happens, it is important for Affliction Warlock to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.
	[center][wrapper width=800px][center][box]
	[ul]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Get your food buff and oil applied![/b][/li]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Summon your Pet![/b][/li]		
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Drop healthstones! -[/b] Cast [spell=29893] for every party/raid member to get a [item=5512][/li]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Portals, portals everywhere! -[/b] As needed, make sure your portals are down in an appropriate location. This includes both personal, [spell=268358] and group, [spell=111771] portals.[/li]
		[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Double Check your Talents! -[/b] Have another quick look to make sure you are in the correct talents for the boss, and you can't see any changes that might help.[/li]
	[/ul]
	[/box][/center][/wrapper][/center]
[/tab]
[/tabs]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c9][icon name=spell_shadow_deathcoil type=round size=medium inline=true color=c9][/icon] Affliction Warlock Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]

[pad]

[tabs name="cds"]
[tab name="Darkglare" icon=inv_beholderwarlock]
[ul]
[li][spell=205180] is your major cooldown on a two-minute CD. It increases the damage of your active DOT effects by 20% while active, which means that you will want to cast Darkglare BEFORE you begin to chain cast Unstable Affliction. This will lead to optimal damage output by having Darkglare's damage amp cover the entire duration of your Unstable Affliction effects. 
[ul]
[/ul]
[/li]

[/ul]
[/tab]

[tab name="Dark Harvest" icon=inv_ability_warlock_soulrot]

[spell=1257052] is a spec tree talent, but functions differently based on whether you choose Soul Harvester or Hellcaller. The ability also has cooldown reduction via [spell=1259886], making it roughly a 40-second cooldown. 

For Hellcaller, it is simply an effect that you will hit when it's off cooldown and you can gain damage value from it, with not much else to it. For Soul Harvester, however, it is the main capstone of the Hero Talent Tree in [spell=449638]. This effect grants you 3 Soul Shards every time you cast Dark Harvest, vastly increasing Affliction's Shard generation and overall Quality of Life. This also gives you a tad bit more CDR via Cull the Weak for Soul Harvester over Hellcaller, due to the increased Shards per minute it grants. 
[/tab]
[tab name="Malevolence" icon=inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_malevolence]

[spell=442726] is your Hellcaller capstone ability and has a 1-minute cooldown. Due to the nature of Malevolence and the new [spell=1266799] Hero Talent, you will want to pair this with every Darkglare cast. This means that you can cast Malevolence every minute, and have it pair back with Darkglare every two minutes. 

The effect itself is quite strong, granting the player a small Haste buff, while increasing the stack count of EACH active [spell=445465] by 6, and also causing targets affected by Wither to take damage. 
[/tab]

[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c9][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c9][/icon] Affliction Warlock Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]

[pad]

[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Gameplay" icon=inv_beholderwarlock]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c9] Gameplay and Pandemic [/color][/h3]
	Affliction is not very complicated in Midnight, even with [spell=1259790] returning as your spender. You will want to cast [spell=1257052 ] essentially on CD, as long as you are not going to overcap on Soul Shards. Keep in mind that Dark Harvest only generates Soul Shards as Soul Harvester, not Hellcaller. 


Outside of that, you will want to maintain Unstable Affliction while also passively pooling shards for your [spell=205180] window. You will also want to sync your Dark Harvest to your Darkglare window, to generate Shards (as Soul Harvester) once your pre-pooled shards have been spent. 

While it is not a massive DPS loss to refresh before your Pandemic window, it is still something to min/max. Refreshing DOTs on the move however is a DPS gain (over casting nothing) and is one of the main perks of Affliction, it's incredibly mobile.


[center]

[b]DOT Pandemic Range
Agony - 4.5 Seconds
Corruption/Wither - 4.2 Seconds
[/b]

[/center]
[/tab]
[/tabs]
[pad]
